name: proto-blocks/cadco-hero
title: Cadco Hero
description: Full-bleed hero: a background photograph behind a directional dark scrim, with an eyebrow line, display heading and call-to-action button aligned to the left.

heading.label: Heading
heading.default: America's Leader in Innovative Foodservice Equipment

headingLine2.label: Heading, second line
headingLine2.help: Optional. Given a value, it is drawn on its own line under the heading, so a two-sentence headline breaks exactly where you want it instead of wherever the column happens to run out.

body.label: Body
body.help: Optional. A short paragraph under the heading; the home page hero leaves it empty.

background.label: Background
background.help: Gradient is for heroes with no photograph behind them, such as the About page.

headingScale.label: Headline size
headingScale.help: Display is the full-height headline the home, products and about heroes carry. Compact is a step down, for an inner page whose hero is a title rather than a statement.

backgroundImage.label: Background image
backgroundImage.help: Sits behind the scrim. Landscape photography works best — the right half stays legible while the left is darkened for the text.

scrimOpacity.label: Scrim strength
scrimOpacity.help: Darkness of the left-to-right gradient over the photo. The design uses 74.

minHeight.label: Height (px)
minHeight.help: Desktop height. The design is 841px beneath the 77px header, making the 918px hero in Figma.

highlight.label: Highlighted word
highlight.help: A word or phrase from the headline to backlight, as the design does with "Experience.". Matched once, ignoring case, across both headline lines. Leave empty for no highlight.
